title_or_table: Claim CL1514, union membership, and its source S04, the Bureau of Labor Statistics release Union Members, 2025
unit: members_pct in percent of employed wage and salary workers; members_millions in millions
vintage: Atlas V7 snapshot of October 15, 2026; the Bureau’s release of February 18, 2026
qualification: The 2025 figures average 11 months, since the October 2025 survey was not collected during the shutdown, and the Bureau’s note in V7 says 2025 is not strictly comparable with other annual averages. The Bureau’s release itself was not read: bls.gov refused this container (HTTP 403) on November 12, 2026.

members_millions.description: union members, where V7 records the count

note.description: the limitation that travels with the figure

printed_source_line: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Union Members, 2025 (February 18, 2026), employed wage and salary workers, 2025, United States, as recorded in Oath & Action’s systems atlas, Who Do They Answer To?, snapshot of October 15, 2026. The 2025 average covers 11 months, since the October 2025 survey was not collected.
